about: Verbatim Alpha Vantage notice texts (HTTP 200 JSON bodies) as quoted in public issue reports, with the classification both the web and desktop apps must produce. Keys are replaced by placeholders. Sources: audit Appendix A.3.

notices.name: burst-2026
notices.text: Thank you for using Alpha Vantage! Please consider spreading out your free API requests more sparingly (1 request per second). You may subscribe to any of the premium plans at https://www.alphavantage.co/premium/ to lift the free key rate limit (25 requests per day), raise the per-second burst limit, and instantly unlock all premium endpoints

notices.name: daily
notices.text: Thank you for using Alpha Vantage! Our standard API rate limit is 25 requests per day. Please subscribe to any of the premium plans at https://www.alphavantage.co/premium/ to instantly remove all daily rate limits.

notices.name: daily-variant
notices.text: We have detected your API key as KEYPLACEHOLDER1 and our standard API rate limit is 25 requests per day. Please subscribe to any of the premium plans at https://www.alphavantage.co/premium/ to instantly remove all daily rate limits.

notices.name: premium-endpoint
notices.text: Thank you for using Alpha Vantage! This is a premium endpoint. You may subscribe to any of the premium plans at https://www.alphavantage.co/premium/ to instantly unlock all premium endpoints

notices.name: demo-key
notices.text: The **demo** API key is for demo purposes only. Please claim your free API key at (https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key) to explore our full API offerings. It takes fewer than 20 seconds.

notices.name: missing-key
notices.text: the parameter apikey is invalid or missing. Please claim your free API key on (https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key). It should take less than 20 seconds.

notices.name: invalid-call
notices.text: Invalid API call. Please retry or visit the documentation (https://www.alphavantage.co/documentation/) for TIME_SERIES_DAILY.

notices.name: legacy-per-minute-note
notices.text: Thank you for using Alpha Vantage! Our standard API call frequency is 5 calls per minute and 500 calls per day. Please visit https://www.alphavantage.co/premium/ if you would like to target a higher API call frequency.

notices.name: unknown-information
notices.text: Thank you for using Alpha Vantage! The service is undergoing maintenance; please try again later.
